builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Page component with 5+ useState calls and multiple useMemo/useCallback blocks; identify which concerns depend only on Redux selectors + dispatch (not on other useState values in the same component)
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Extract any concern that reads only its own selectors and dispatches only its own actions to a use<Concern> hook; the hook returns computed state + stable callbacks; the page calls the hook and passes results to JSX
builder_notes.stack_example: useTierFilter.ts: reads selectTiers/selectSortMode/selectFilters; returns processedTiers/filteredItems/4 dispatch callbacks; zero dependency on modal state

builder_notes.pattern: Extraction without tests at new Interface
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: New hook file created; no corresponding .test.ts; behavior was untested inline before and remains untested after extraction
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For every new hook that calls dispatch or reads from the store, add one renderHook test: mount with a configured store, trigger the side effect, assert state changed
builder_notes.stack_example: useTierFilter test: create store; call handleSortModeChange({type:'alphabetical',ascending:true}); assert processedTiers.S is sorted alphabetically

builder_notes.pattern: Test coverage asymmetry between similar functions
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: One function in a module has 8 tests; a similar function has 0; both are called from the same consumer path
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When adding tests for sortItems, add tests for filterItems/filterAllTiers in the same test session
builder_notes.stack_example: packages/core/test/sorting.test.ts has 8 tests; packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts does not exist; both are called inside useTierFilter's processedTiers useMemo
